definitions.full: H5679. abarah עֲבָרָה noun feminine ford , rare synonym of מַעְבָּרָה מַעֲבָר ; — absolute ׳הָע 2Sam 19:19 and they crossed the ford (see עבר Qal 1 a ); plural construct הַמִּדְבָּר עַברוֺת 15:28 Kt (Qr עַרְבוֺת ), so 17:16 van d. occurrences.englishText: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness, until word comes from you to inform me.”

He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
